# Project Instructions

This repository is **skill-agents-management** — a skill plus the
`agents-management` CLI for spawning and managing heterogeneous agentic
systems. See `README.md` for what it is and `docs/architecture.md` for the
plugin model.

## Mandatory skills

- **project-management** — every change here is tracked on this repository's
  own `.task-board/` via the `task-board` CLI. Follow the skill's
  orchestrator/specialist contract: decompose to epics/stories/tasks before
  implementing, route artifact-producing work through tracked spawned runs,
  close stories by commits. Never edit `.task-board/` files directly.
- **go-testing-tools** — all Go test authoring and test tooling in this
  repository follows that skill (helpers, golden files, closed-loop patterns).
  Use it before inventing test scaffolding.

## Ground rules carried from the extraction source

This tool is being extracted from `skill-project-management`'s spawn plane.
Until the extraction completes, treat that repository as the behavioural
reference:

- **Observable launch surface is the parity bar** — argv, environment, stdin
  bytes and side effects; argv-string equality is not parity.
- **Limit state is fail-open** — an absent state file reads as "provider
  healthy". The on-disk identity (`IdentityKey(provider, home)` feeding the
  state filename) must never move silently.
- **Admitted-pair digests are frozen compatibility surfaces** — a digest that
  changes silently invalidates pinned snapshots downstream.
- **Reasoning effort is a required per-model axis** — no defaults at call
  sites; refusals name the exact dotted config key and the accepted values.
- **Plugin boundaries**: agentic-system plugins (the harness that runs a turn)
  are one layer; vendor plugins (who owns models, auth and quota) are another
  and depend on agentic-system plugins. Roles, tasks, Change Requests and
  worktree isolation stay in task-board — they never enter this tool.
